parallel_evidence_fused.generator_structure: 4 templates x 6 S3 mappings x 3 semantic classes

new_counterhypothesis_found.claim_under_attack: A fully crossed 72-row S3 seed can be treated directly as TRAIN while also evaluating unseen S3 permutation generalization.
new_counterhypothesis_found.reason: S3 for three classes has exactly six permutations. If TRAIN contains all six, no S3 permutation remains unseen. Therefore the 72-row matrix must remain an upstream design matrix or the acceptance term 'unseen permutation' must be redefined before evaluation.
preserved_source_requirements: full S3 mapping family must be represented across the corpus/evaluation design
unseen-permutation generalization target remains >=0.90 unless a newer preregistration changes its meaning

second_counterhypothesis.claim_under_attack: Simply hold one or two S3 patterns out from a fixed three-symbol training seed and counterbalance remains solved.
second_counterhypothesis.reason: Removing S3 patterns from a fixed ATOM_A/B/C triplet creates nonzero class-to-symbol identity dependence even though display order can remain balanced. The materializer must counterbalance over many actual accepted atom triplets/assignments, not only over permutation IDs.
second_counterhypothesis.measured_design_implication: Class-symbol MI and per-symbol class counts must be computed on realized materialized rows after split assignment.

stage_0_template_matrix.purpose: Exercise every template/S3/class combination as a generator design oracle only.

requires: exact accepted 46-atom ABI inventory plus manifest/source identity
stage_1_materializer.rule: Instantiate many distinct accepted-atom triplets and atom orderings so TRAIN realized class-symbol identity is counterbalanced even when one or more S3 patterns are reserved for validation/holdout.

stage_2_split_axes: TRAIN_CORE: materialized rows using preregistered training S3 subset and training atom pool
VALIDATION_PERM: validation-only S3 pattern(s), never used for training updates
HOLDOUT_PERM: frozen S3 pattern(s) absent from train/validation tuning
HOLDOUT_SYMBOL: frozen accepted ABI atoms absent from all training triplets
HOLDOUT_TEMPLATE: T5_FROZEN_UNSEEN plus disjoint semantic lexical ancestry
required_post_materialization_statistics: full S3 coverage across the complete train/validation/holdout evaluation corpus
no S3 ID overlap between TRAIN_CORE and HOLDOUT_PERM
no accepted atom identity overlap between TRAIN_CORE and HOLDOUT_SYMBOL
per-symbol TRAIN class counts differ by at most one
TRAIN empirical I(class; emitted_atom) <= 1e-6 bits for the audited deterministic seed
codebook display order independent from realized mapping and target position

new_fail_closed_gate.purpose: Validate materialized split rows rather than the upstream 72-row placeholder matrix.
notable_checks: explicit [CODEBOOK] span and external label/synonym leakage rejection
full S3 total coverage plus unseen-permutation holdout isolation
class-symbol exact/near-exact balance and MI gate

training_example_policy_delta.positive_examples: Generate counterfactual bundles, not isolated rows: same semantic case with changed codebook must change atom; same codebook with changed semantic case must follow mapping; codebook order change must not change target; lexical paraphrase must preserve target.
hard_negatives: metadata permutation changes but realized codebook does not
target symbol disagrees with realized mapping
class-symbol MI shortcut survives apparent display-order randomization
cross-model Qwen3-0.6B J-Space label is promoted into Qwen3.5 positive target

next_exact_action: Obtain the exact 46 accepted atom inventory and frozen lexeme inventories, implement the evidence-bound materializer from the canonical 72-row matrix, then run generic candidate validation plus trigger2_dynamic_codebook_binding_gate_v1.1 on the emitted split corpus before scaling or any training pilot.
